name: Private Kernel
desc:
Private Kernel is a Celtor NPC. He possesses information on who [The Central Authority](faction:the_central_authority) contains in the [Merit Detainment Core](location:merit_detainment_core).

He is equipped with an Authority Helm, a green-dyed Plain Cape, Leather Boots, and the Authority Peacekeeper Outfit. On his back, he wields an Adretian Axe.
additional_info:
-   Before the player chooses the dialogue option "Why does he scare you, private?", Private Kernel is named as "Struggling Guard."
-   His full name is a play on the words corn kernel.
